pages.title: Gaia agent team architecture
pages.description:
A single 16:9 scientific journal figure on a pure white #FFFFFF background. Clean flat vector style, no 3D, no gradients, no shadows, no photographs, no logos, no watermark, no page number. Thin crisp strokes, generous white space, typeface a neutral sans-serif. This is a scientific paper figure, NOT a marketing slide.

LAYOUT: five horizontal layer bands stacked vertically, each spanning most of the width, with a downward arrow between consecutive bands, plus one long feedback arrow running down the right-hand margin from the bottom band back up to the middle band.

CRITICAL VISUAL RULE — three different border styles encode three levels of authority, and this distinction is the point of the figure:
  - DASHED thin border = fast but may not assign value
  - SOLID thin border = may reason but may not veto
  - HEAVY THICK border in a warm red accent = the only component allowed to assign value

First band, at the top: solid thin border, cool grey accent. Left label in bold: 'L1  DATA'. Two module chips inside: 'data engineer' and 'cartographer'. One line of small text beneath: 'raw simulation deck to 7,900 structured cases   |   471 cases to 4x22 inter-well influence map'. Small metric chip on the right: '1 min per case'.

The second band ): solid thin border, purple accent. Left label in bold: 'L2  KNOWLEDGE'. One module chip: 'knowledge curator'. Beneath it three short stacked items: 'deck audit: what the model does NOT contain', 'field literature: titles and DOIs only', 'domain corpus: general waterflood principles'. On the right a small tag reading exactly: 'runs once, offline'.

The third band ): solid thin border, blue accent. Left label in bold: 'L3  REASONING'. SIX role chips in one row, labelled exactly: 'constraint audit', 'economics', 'connectivity', 'reservoir', 'surveillance', '4D seismic'. Beneath: 'independent pass, then cross-examination, then adjudication by evidence strength — not by head count'.

The fourth band ): DASHED thin border, green accent. Left label in bold: 'L4  EVALUATION'. Two chips: 'surrogate' and 'feasibility auditor'. Beneath: 'screens candidates   |   arithmetic gate, never delegated to a language model'. Metric chip on the right: '18.1 microseconds per candidate'.

Fifth band, at the bottom: HEAVY THICK border in warm red. Left label in bold: 'L5  ADJUDICATION'. One chip: 'full-physics simulator'. Beneath in slightly larger text: 'the only component permitted to assign value'. Metric chip on the right: '2.7 runs per decision'.

FEEDBACK ARROW: a single curved arrow along the right margin, from band 5 up to band 3, labelled 'measured outcome fed back'.

LEGEND, small, bottom-left, three entries with matching border styles: 'dashed — fast, no pricing authority', 'solid — reasoning, no veto', 'heavy — pricing authority'.

DO NOT print the words 'band', 'first', 'second', 'third', 'fourth' or 'fifth' anywhere in the image — those are layout instructions to you, not visible text. The only bold left-hand labels are 'L1  DATA', 'L2  KNOWLEDGE', 'L3  REASONING', 'L4  EVALUATION', 'L5  ADJUDICATION'.

Text economy: use only the words specified above. Do NOT invent extra labels, taglines, numbers, axis text, or decorative micro-text. Every number shown must be exactly one of: 7,900 / 471 / 4x22 / 1 min / 18.1 microseconds / 2.7. Spell all words correctly.
